title: 布兰德·余烬长阶
description: 布兰德穿完整深色长外衣，在石阶上静立，炭色面容与琥珀眼光可辨，火元素只在身上作受控轮廓光。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Brand is an elemental adult humanoid with a charcoal-dark face, glowing amber eyes, and orange fissure-like light defining his recognizable fire-touched form. Preserve the elemental facial structure while adding a fully covering dark high-collared coat, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. Controlled flame-shaped light stays close to his own silhouette, without burning a person, surrounding object, or landscape.
art_direction.scene: Place him motionless on broad empty basalt steps, both hands lowered and fingers relaxed, looking toward a distant pale horizon. A hard cool light enters from one side while restrained ember edges illuminate the opposite contours. Use angular wax-crayon planes and large architectural shadows, with no fireball, erupting ground, smoke drama, or frightened figures in the spacious scene.
art_direction.palette: charcoal violet, ember orange, cold slate, pale silver
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
